items.note: S1.3.1 names the copy/gather/scatter/side-injection gates over triples, the exchange up to sign and restoration of arbitrary scratch values, but gives no h=100, N or m, no net-change identity (JV+RG)x=x, and says the bank is added three times whereas stage 2 subtracts (X<-X-Y).

S1.3.2 states the frames D_v, edge changes D_vD_u^{-1}, the commuting of a common frame with a pointwise gate and the implemented operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, matching eq:common-frame-identity; the invariant argument is only named, not unfolded.

S1.3.3 has nondegenerate nested labels in an m-dimensional space built from triples, and its quote points to the central-wire edges from time 3 to 4, but it gives no loss h, no L=Ich, no budget Wm-2N+2L and no ratios L/N=100/539, 101/539; it also equates the residual total with s, which for the bit network omits the extra N source ranks.

S1.3.4 states the frames Phi_M, the shear H<-H+D on every role and total rank s<Wm, but omits the projection assignment (P_U, -P_{U_a}), the endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m that makes the shear uniform, and the value s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.

S1.4.1 states that phase frames of binary labels make each edge a product of translation kernels, one per residual basis vector, but omits the frame C_U, s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m and the telescoped C^{tensor m} on every role.
The plan states s<Wm and s/W<m^tau with tau<1, but never says why (L<N/2, deficit N-2L), nor the deficits eta_b, eta_c, nor tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20.

S1.1 lists digit moves, split/merge and row splits in O(V) on fixed tapes; S1.2 states the controlled update of a later field and the unit multiplication in O(V), with the b^{O(1)} preparation condition carried by its quote.

S1.3.6 states A=E_1 Pi E_2 with exactly a ones and S1.3.7 the cost of exactly a interchanges plus O(V), one swap per pivot; the elimination proof and the triangular transforms around Pi are not shown.

S1.3.8 and S1.3.5 give the row split into W role streams, edges by s smaller interchanges, the three-update interchange, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) and O(Ve^tau), along the paper's route; but the endpoint identity that makes the frame telescope to Phi_{I_m}, the row-field divisibility by W^k and the fixed-tape depth-first schedule are missing.
S1.3.9 states padding, base-m decomposition and O(Vu^tau), but does not say that rho=O(log e) high digits of the chunks are joined into the row field that the power-width calls need.

S1.4.1 gives H_0^{tensor D}=const*S_D C^{tensor D} S_D and the kernel-per-residual-vector edge factorization, and S1.4.3 one child per basis vector; the conjugation by P_M putting the directions in coordinate slots and the inverse-child identity are only alluded to as binary changes of basis.

S1.4.2 states XOR of selected bits by a constant number of whole-chunk cyclic shifts plus deterministic repair of an identified exceptional set at cost O(V(L^tau+1)), but drops delta_bad and the extra cost terms and the parameter-family condition under which that bound holds.

S1.4.3 states the m-slot split, rows over W roles, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) and O(d^lambda'), but omits the leaves F(e)=O(e) for e<d^beta, the q_0 row index, the base-m pieces and the condition on lambda'.

S1.4 states the layer at O(Vd^lambda') with one truncation of error below sqrt2 2^{-p}, and its sub-steps follow the paper's proof (phase frames, packed additions, recurrence, guard width, conversion, row sums one); the guard-width bound is asserted without its arithmetic-depth recurrence and the row-index construction is missing.

S2.1 and S2.2 state omega_t=y^{2r/t}, bit-reversed output, inversion up to 1/t, the layout permutation and the cost O(Tp[dK+pK^{tau-1}+l d^lambda']), but omit the error sqrt2 l 2^{-p} and the exact counterparts LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}.
S2.3 states exact products by evaluation at a power of two with the established multiplier in O(rp log(rp)), but not B_0=2^{4p}, the reduction modulo y^r+1, or that Q_p(fg/r) is returned.

S2 states the error bound sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p} and the method, and S2.4 gives the commutation of pointwise products with the record permutation, as at 3436-3438; the exact final multiplication by M is missing (S2.4 attributes (f*g)/(rM) to the opposite transform alone) and the error accumulation is not shown.

S3.1 matches lem:no-sort-resampling (theta>p/alpha^4, P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA, cost O(tp^{3/2+delta}alpha)) and S3.2 the tensor form with error below dp^2; the permutations P_s, P_t are not defined and the axis-exposure cost is not given.

S3.3 states QF_t as chirp multiplication, convolution with a divided by T, chirp multiplication, and S3.4 states the cancellation to (u*v)/S^2; the chirp a_j=exp(-pi i sum s_i j_i^2/t_i) itself is never given.
S4.1 gives b, p=6b, d, K, T in [4n/b,8n/b), axis lengths and primes below t_i with T/2<S<T, but omits the fixed rational exponents, alpha, gamma, eta and the bracket (1-2eta)t_i<s_i<=(1-eta)t_i.
S4.3 states Phi: x -> prod x_i^{mu_i} as an algebra isomorphism done by triangular controlled shifts, but mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i and the triangular digit formula are not given.
S4.4 states that multiplying coefficient k by zeta^k, zeta=e^{pi i/r}, maps length-r cyclic convolution to the ring modulo y^r+1, as in the paper.

S4.5 matches the source transform (A, chirp transform, B_0, scale 2^gamma) and S4.6 the six-step algorithm with the two occurrences of S and the scale 2^{2b+4}; the input scale 2^{-b-2} is implicit only in that final scale.

S5.1-S5.3 give the disk margins, the final bound 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2 and the carry bound q(2^b-1), but the error chain E_ring<5TL, E_s=9 2^gamma TL, E_w<28 2^gamma T^2 L and the use of gamma<=b/4 are not shown.
S6.1 reproduces the seven normalized costs of tab:costs, S6.2 min g_i=2^{-181}=2kappa, and S6.3 the absorption of log powers into p^kappa and the total O(n(log n)^{1-kappa}), as in the paper.
No step mentions the Schonhage-Strassen conjecture or the liminf negation; S0 only states the time bound.

errors.says: The network adds one bank into the other three times to exchange X and Y up to sign.
errors.paper: Stage 2 runs the inverse schedule from Y to X, which effects X<-X-Y; the three stages give (x,y+x), (-y,y+x), (-y,x).

errors.says: The orthogonal residual dimensions over all edges total s<Wm.
errors.paper: The residual dimensions total Wm-2N+2L; the bit network's rank sum s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b adds N source ranks from the negative source projections (rank one where the dimension change is zero).

errors.says: Multiplying the forward outputs in their retained order and applying the opposite transform gives (f*g)/(rM).
errors.paper: The opposite transform's result is then multiplied exactly by M=T/r; without that scale the composition gives (f*g)/(rM^2).

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound: two fast tape procedures (S1.3, S1.4), synthetic convolution (S2), resampling with chirp and permutation cancellation (S3), the assembled algorithm (S4), exact recovery (S5) and the cost table with min g_i=2kappa (S6). It thins out in the central saving: S1.3.3-S1.3.5 assert s<Wm and s/W<m^tau without the dimension budget Wm-2N+2L, the ratio L/N<1/2, the rank-equals-dimension-change argument or the endpoint identity, so the reason for the saving is stated rather than derived. The error chain in S5 is also stated only at its end points.

steps.note: The gates over triples, exchange up to sign and scratch restoration are there, but h=100, the triple-indexed banks with N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are absent, so the defining quantities are missing (conservative verdict).
S1.3.2 states the invertible frame per vertex, its commuting with pointwise gates, D_out S D_in^{-1} and edge cost D_vD_u^{-1}.

Nondegenerate nested labels of an m-dimensional space built from triples are stated, but the claim omits that the only decreasing edges are the central wires from time 3 to 4, each losing h; the quote names those edges only in a truncated fragment.
The plan implicitly equates edge cost with residual dimension but never states that P_V-P_U has rank dim V-dim U, nor the N rank-one source exceptions.
Only 'the residual dimensions total s<Wm'; no budget Wm-2N+2L, no L=Ich, no s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
s<Wm is asserted as the strict deficit, but L/N=100/539 or 101/539 below 1/2 and the deficit N-2L>0 that produce it are absent.
The shear H<-H+D on every role is stated, but the endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m that produces it is not.
E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), one swap per pivot, and s calls per node are all stated.
The recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) on volume V/W and O(e^tau) from s/W<m^tau are stated, but tau=1-2^{-50} and its derivation from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20 are absent; conservative verdict.

central.summary: The plan carries the frame mechanism (C2) and the edge-to-recursive-call accounting (C8), and states the recurrence abstractly, but it does not rebuild the source of the saving: the labels' decreasing edges, rank equals dimension change, the budget Wm-2N+2L, L/N<1/2 and the endpoint identity are named or implied without their content, and the explicit exponent is missing. Two of nine steps are reconstructed.
